text:
riley: ACME-Edge wants a private offer that bundles a 12mo split-pay commit + hardware trade-in credit (appliance buyback), plus 40 SI hours. They want a coordinated marketplace listing and joint announcement in ~5 weeks. Need pricing mechanics and how buyback shows on PO.

jon: Sales: propose split-pay ($120k upfront + $80k at month 6) for $200k annual commit. Discount ladder:
  - Base $200k -> 17% off
  - >= $500k -> 24% off + $20k buyback credit
  - >= $900k -> 30% off + $50k buyback credit + priority SI hours
Include 45-day opt-out on renewal.

tara: Ops: buyback handled off-marketplace via partner ops portal; marketplace will show gross price + metadata "estimated_buyback". If partner integration available, we can show net but ETA 7-9 weeks.

miguel: Finance: buyback recorded as contra-revenue, amortized over remaining months. For split-pay we need clear invoicing milestone and revenue allocation. Also require clawback schedule: recoup 60% month1, 25% month2, 15% month3 if commit shortfall.

legal-bot: Legal: approve with conditions: buyback voucher expiry 120 days, non-transferable, audit rights for redemptions, and a limited-publicity clause for co-announcement. Drafting PO annex now.

riley: Plan: publish preview private-offer in staging T-7 with "SI docs pending" flag; final publish when SI runbook and partner buyback flow validated. I'll assemble pricing sheet + annex and share by EOD. tagging @jon @tara @miguel. marketplace-bot: Draft created (po-ACMEEDGE-5234567890). Review window opens in 48h.
